notes:
This page continues a discussion of a section and a subgroup N_s-prime. It says that the subgroup gives almost a lifting, with the inertia factor T still obstructing it, and that a section of the indicated extension gives a section of the special-fiber group, but of the second kind. It then begins another formulation in terms of a rational section f of U/S and the family of points f(s) in the fibers U_s. The final sentence continues beyond this sheet. The underlined words presque and deuxième are the author’s qualifications. The page bears his number 45 and the separate bottom-left folio 90.
Visual review: the whole source image was viewed once, then both full-resolution halves once, comparing every word, formula, sign, subscript, cancellation, underline and placement with C and H. Twenty-two distinct saved crops were inspected once. Original boxes are recorded; crops used grayscale autocontrast, LANCZOS resizing to 2200 pixels width and sharpening. No OCR, text-recognition software, external research, or other leaf was consulted. The line count is twenty main prose rows, excluding the page and folio numbers. There is no diagram or drawing on this leaf.
Reading decisions: the opening is ni =, with the equals sign kept literally. Opening E_tilde U has a rounded U, and the following subscript is O. The two N-identifications instead have the sharp low vertex, oblique rise and returning right leg of the K in deg tr K on this same leaf; Completed adjudication resolves both of these subgroup indices to K; the opening rounded U remains U. No independent comma follows the first N_s-prime. The words trivial kummérien, obstrue, tous, cette, mais de deuxième espèce, and parcourt l’ens are supported by their crops. The abbreviated tr.-scend|tr.-scendance replaces the first-pass expansion transcendance; the final return does not settle the full ending. The accent in kummérien is separate from its i-dot. The source fraction U/S is stacked. The final S has no prime, and the final sentence has no supplied terminal stop.
The small cancelled form below the first simeq is retained as doubtful de|d. Completed adjudication replaces the earlier editorial question-mark placeholder with these tentative letters; no author question mark is asserted. A doubtful abandoned f-like start precedes inline autre; autre itself is not raised or attached by an insertion leader. The struck word before the live article remains leur|le|sur; the live article remains le|de. After corps de, réf is preferred with N retained; the cancelled word before live peut remains peut|permet. The cancelled sublabel remains doubtful in its letters de|d. Certainty-only resolutions have their own list and marks; they are not substantive change rows.
Mathematical checks: no independent proof, computation, refutation or mathematical use was performed. The same-page comparison of K and U is a handwriting comparison, not a mathematical check. check_events is therefore empty. No compilation was performed.
Root review: the whole page and all twenty-two saved crops were inspected. The final cancelled-word reading is leur|le|sur at low confidence; this supersedes the first-pass le|sur preference. No source character is inferred from syntax.

Blind adjudication preserves the abbreviated tr.-scend form: point and dash follow tr, while the long final d return leaves ance uncertain. The earlier full transcendance resolution is withdrawn. The form previously proposed as N after corps de now favors the compressed short form réf, from the low initial turns and long f-like descender, with N still explicit as an alternative. Both subgroup indices resolve to K from the same-page deg tr K and the cross-leaf short-foot controls, rather than U or eta. Cancelled leur is preferred before the live le/de; the sublabel below the isomorphism now reads doubtful de/d rather than an editorial question-mark placeholder. Cancelled peut also admits permet. All fourteen differing boxes were inspected.
